options.npc_answer: I'm not in the mood now, filho da puta!
I just escaped with: [inventory_list]. You look like you've seen better days too.

options.player_question: How do I stay sane out here?
options.npc_answer: Don't just survive; learn. Read everything. Manuals, magazines... it keeps the fear away. Here.
Lucky for us, Next Petrol cut costs and made all the ignition tumblers the same. These keys might work on the Jeeps.
Run. Don't look back at the burning labs. Just run...
The satellite phone died yesterday. Last I heard, Rio went dark. If the capital falls, we're truly alone.

options.player_question: What is the status of the Rigs?
options.npc_answer: They've been fully functional for years, but without the crews... they're just ticking time bombs.
Brazil was the first to close the borders, but it didn't help. It's total chaos down south.
Just rogues, some military and the infected. If it moves and doesn't scream 'don't shoot', it's probably trying to kill you.

options.player_question: Why did the helicopter leave us?
options.npc_answer: Standard containment protocol. Next Petrol doesn't rescue liabilities. We are the liability now.

options.player_question: Did you know about the cure?
options.npc_answer: I saw the crates labeled 'Vaccine-B'. They weren't shipping it out... they were burning it. That's when I knew it was over.
Maybe you can finish my misery.
Stop bothering me before I lose my temper. Every man for himself, remember?
